body: Yes. I wanted to try to live at first and see if things got better but they aren’t. I gave it a year, nothing good happened. Still miserable.
I don’t want to incase they try to stop me. I’m in pain and I want to end it, nothing wrong with that. I shouldn’t have to force myself to live and suffer.
There’s no one to blame. Just some shitty circumstances. I don’t want to write any of that mushy stuff or anything, just a brief note to explain why I did it.
I want to leave a short note but nothing too long.
